34:1.text: to Allāh, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and to Him belongs
praise in the Hereafter. And He is the Wise, the Aware.

34:2.text: He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein. And He is the Merciful, the Forgiving.

34:3.text: But those who disbelieve say, "The Hour will not come to us." Say, "Yes, by my Lord, it will surely come to you.
the Knower of the unseen." Not absent from Him is an atom's weight
within the heavens or within the earth or
smaller than that or greater, except that it is in a clear register -

34:4.text: That He may reward those who believe and do righteous deeds. Those will have forgiveness and noble provision.

34:5.text: But those who strive against Our verses
- for them will be a painful punishment of foul nature.

34:6.text: And those who have been given knowledge see that what is revealed to you from your Lord is the truth, and it guides to the path of the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy.
